lines.text: از منطقة البروج يعني قوسي است از دایره عرضیه که بمرکز کوکب گذرد میان خط تقویمی کوکب

lines.text: و منطقة البروج از جانب عقرب پس شمس را عرض نباشد چه مرکز او دایما در سطح منطقة خارج مرکز

lines.en: not in the plane of the zodiac, but rather it intersects with the zodiac at two opposite points, knowing that the center from it

lines.en: it also intersects the zodiac. And since it is a great circle, the intersection is at two opposite points, just as the equator

lines.text: النهار و منطقة البروج گفتیم انرا يعني آن نقطه را از دو نقطه مذکوره که قمر چون بحرکت خاص
lines.en: and the zodiac. We said that, meaning that point from the two mentioned points, that the Moon, when by its proper motion

lines.en: passes from it and its latitude becomes northern, meaning it comes towards the north of the zodiac, is the Head, and metaphorically

lines.text: شمالي قمر گویند و راس و ذنب بسبب آن گویند که شکلي را که حادث شده است در مابین
lines.en: they call it the northern Moon. And they call it Head and Tail because of the shape that has occurred between

lines.text: نصف مایل و نصف ممثل از جانب جنوب تشبیه کرده اند باژدهاي مستوي طرفین او این نقطه
lines.en: the inclined half and the parecliptic half from the south side, they have likened it to a dragon with straight ends, this point

lines.text: است و تحقیق مجاز شمالي براس و مجاز جنوبي بذنب بسبب سعادت اول و نحوست ثانیست
lines.en: is. And the investigation of the northern metaphor for the Head and the southern metaphor for the Tail is due to the auspiciousness of the first and the inauspiciousness of the second.

lines.text: و هر دو را عقدتین و جوزهرین خوانند اما تسمیه ایشان بعقدتین بسبب آنکه تشبیه کرده اند بهر گره
lines.en: And both are called the two nodes and the two nodes. But their naming as the two nodes is because they have likened them to every knot

lines.text: بعقده که در میان دو خط افتد چنانکه انجا عبارت از این دو دایره است و اما بجوزهرین
lines.en: to a knot that falls between two lines, just as there it is an expression of these two circles. And as for the two nodes

lines.en: some say because node is the Arabicized form of walnut knot, which means the same as the first meaning, and some

lines.en: passes, as in most climes, except the northern descending, as in some, and from its extreme latitude until reaching

sections.text: و ان دیگر را که قمر از و بگذرد و عرضش جنوبي شود نقطه ذنب و مجازا جنوبي قمر گویند
sections.en: And the other one, which the Moon passes from and its latitude becomes southern, is called the point of the Tail and metaphorically the southern Moon.

summary.headline: The Moon’s Two Nodes
summary.text: Explanation of the Moon’s ascending and descending nodes, or Head and Tail, where its orbit intersects the zodiac; discusses their dragon and knot metaphors, auspiciousness, and the Moon’s changing latitude up to about five degrees.
